mapper.select: SELECT act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id, act03_dr_account_cd AS dr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_dr_account_cd) AS dr_account_name, act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_dr_ast_id) AS dr_ast_name, act03_cr_account_cd AS cr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_cr_account_cd) AS cr_account_name, act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_cr_ast_id) AS cr_ast_name FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date = #{payDate} AND act02_pay_month_cd = #{payType} ORDER BY act03_seq

SELECT f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name, f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name, f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS note, CASE WHEN COALESCE(drAst.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' THEN act03_dr_amt ELSE act03_dr_for_amt END AS dr_for_amt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(crAst.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' THEN act03_cr_amt ELSE act03_cr_for_amt END AS cr_for_amt FROM act03_journal_dtl INNER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_journal_id = act03_journal_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree drAst ON drAst.ast01_class_tree_id = act03_dr_ast_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree crAst ON crAst.ast01_class_tree_id = act03_cr_ast_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date = #{date} AND ( (#{drCrType} = 'D' AND act03_dr_ast_id = #{astId}) OR (#{drCrType} = 'C' AND act03_cr_ast_id = #{astId}) ) ORDER BY act02_journal_no, act03_seq

SELECT act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id , f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name , act03_dr_account_cd AS dr_account_code , f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_dr_account_cd) ||CASE WHEN act03_dr_ast_id is null THEN '' ELSE '('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_dr_ast_id)||')' END AS dr_ast_account_name , act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt , act03_dr_note AS dr_note , act03_cr_account_cd AS cr_account_code , f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_cr_account_cd) ||CASE WHEN act03_cr_ast_id is null THEN '' ELSE '('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_cr_ast_id)||')' END AS cr_ast_account_name , act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt , act03_cr_note AS cr_note FROM act02_journal LEFT OUTER JOIN ast06_tr ON ast06_tr_id = act02_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast07_settle ON ast07_settle_id = act02_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz01_promo_id = act02_biz_id , act03_journal_dtl WHERE act02_journal_id = act03_journal_id AND act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_journal_id = #{journalId} ORDER BY act03_seq
